headline: Of 72 launched CME markets, at most 3 have ANY Uniswap v4 pool.
ZERO pools carry a hook, so no market has an official hooked pool -- none has migrated.
All three existing pools are hookless third-party pools charging 20%, 90% and 99.369%.

caveats: The 4,000,000-block window covers ~4.66 days at the measured block time; the earliest market was created 2026-09-08, about 2 days before capture, so the window covers the full life of every market.
A pool could exist on a non-v4 venue (a v3 factory, or another PoolManager). This census covers only PoolManager 0x8366a39c... Task D should widen it before claiming a token has no pool anywhere.
POOLS_DETAIL (per-pool token, tx hash and block for the three pools) was still being re-emitted when this snapshot was written -- see the next session's first action in SESSION-STATE.md.
